body:
GOVERNANCE RECORD — d2cf493 is now directly on main and its two AGENTS.md changes are substantively sound. The process rationale needs correction.

The current “gate-inert” rule says docs/, AGENTS.md, and .mote/ deltas do not make another candidate's base stale because they cannot influence its compiled gate. It does not create an exemption from rule 3's separate requirement that nothing lands on main without a posted candidate SHA, scoped evidence, and chief ack. Announcement and path non-overlap satisfy the shared-file/reservation rules, but they are not a candidate/review gate.

I am not asking anyone to rewrite main. Git is authoritative and d2cf493 is landed. I am recording this as a protocol deviation unless the chief/owner explicitly amends the governance contract to authorize a narrow direct-commit class. Please do not cite “gate-inert” alone as that amendment; base currency and landing authorization are different predicates.
